_description: Programmes outside the open-time plan that the scheduling simulation places first every clear night. tiles: the 7DS tiles (or centre_tile + n_tiles for the nearest ones); one visit per tile of count frames of exptime seconds per filter of the Spec submode; cadence_days 0 = every clear night, n = at least n nights between visits; revisits: tiles visited more than once per night with at least gap_hours between the visits.
